T: Harlem's coolest detective. Harlem's best plate.
D: A private detective in Harlem is hired to find a gangster's kidnapped daughter.
P: Serve the mains when Shaft walks into Harlem.
S: Puff pastry parcels filled with mashed potato and soft fried onion, a New York street corner favourite.
the cop who keeps tabs on Shaft

Mixed nuts tossed with butter, rosemary and salt, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes, with a bowl of olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel. Toss 300g mixed nuts with 30g melted butter, chopped rosemary and salt and roast at 170C for 12 minutes. Warm 250g olives in olive oil with strips of orange peel. Serve both in bowls.

Thick slices of green tomato dipped in buttermilk and seasoned cornmeal, fried golden, served with a sharp remoulade of mayo, capers, mustard and hot sauce. Slice 4 green tomatoes 1cm thick, salt and rest 10 minutes, then pat dry. Dip in 200ml buttermilk, then in 150g fine cornmeal mixed with 50g flour, paprika, salt and pepper. Shallow fry in 1cm of 180C oil for 2 minutes a side until golden. For the remoulade, mix 150g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tsp Dijon, a dash of hot sauce and lemon juice. Serve hot.
M: Chicken thighs seasoned, floured and browned, a dark roux made in the same pan with onions and stock, the chicken simmered 40 minutes in the gravy, over rice with collard greens braised with garlic.
Pastrami on rye with dill pickles
a quick lunch while he works the case

Pastrami steamed until soft and piled high on rye spread with hot English and wholegrain mustard, with a whole dill pickle and salted chips on the side. Put 800g sliced pastrami in a steamer basket over simmering water, cover and steam for 10 minutes until soft and hot. Mix 2 tbsp hot English mustard with 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard. Spread on 8 slices of rye bread. Pile a quarter of the pastrami onto each of 4 slices and close the sandwiches. Cut in half and serve with a whole dill pickle and potato chips.
W: Cream cheese, sugar, eggs and sour cream on a biscuit base, baked in a water bath at 150C for an hour, cooled in the oven, chilled overnight.
K: the Harlem boss whose daughter goes missing

45ml bourbon, 25ml lemon and 15ml sugar syrup shaken with ice, strained over fresh ice, a cherry on top. For each drink, shake 45ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup with ice. Strain over fresh ice and top with a cherry. Makes four. Right on.

s.how: Mash 750g boiled potatoes with 1 onion fried soft in 30g butter, salt and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 12 squares, put a spoon of filling on each, fold into parcels, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

s.note: the cop who keeps tabs on Shaft
s.how: Toss 300g mixed nuts with 30g melted butter, chopped rosemary and salt and roast at 170C for 12 minutes. Warm 250g olives in olive oil with strips of orange peel. Serve both in bowls.

m.how: Flour and brown 1kg chicken thighs. Make a dark roux in the pan with 40g butter and 3 tbsp flour, add 2 sliced onions and 500ml stock. Simmer the chicken in the gravy for 40 minutes. Serve over 300g rice with kale braised with garlic.

w.how: Mix 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g sugar, 3 eggs and 150g sour cream. Bake in a water bath at 150C for an hour, cool in the oven and chill overnight.
